club_zone_features.title: Squad registry

home.about_desc_1: DEPRO comes from years of experience in the field. Every plan, every block, every session is designed with its own methodological approach — it's not a generic fitness app.
home.about_desc_2: The physical trainer behind DEPRO maintains total control over content, aesthetics and methodological consistency. You receive the result of that experience, adapted to your reality.
home.results_subtitle: Not anonymous testimonials. Verified names, clubs and results.
home.methodology_title: Your monthly plan, ready in seconds.
home.methodology_desc: Our modular system assembles your plan from your form responses: all training sessions, loads, exercises and monthly progressions. No waiting, no meetings.

process_steps.title: Form
process_steps.desc: Fill in your details: age, level, position, goal, frequency, available equipment and injuries.

process_steps.title: Choose plan
process_steps.desc: Basic Plan (instant monthly plan) or Premium (monthly plan with trainer follow-up).

process_steps.title: Pay online
process_steps.desc: Secure payment with Stripe. Club discount code if applicable.

process_steps.title: Plan ready
process_steps.desc: In seconds you receive your complete monthly plan with all training sessions.

process_steps.title: Train
process_steps.desc: Access your private dashboard, follow the sessions and receive adjustments if you have Premium.
